result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there is one clear bug: an untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as a section heading instead of actual text. Other elements (delivery address, search, category chips, promo banner, restaurant cards, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing/failed translation string.
issues.suggestion: Add the proper translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the localization files and ensure the i18n fallback resolves to a readable string rather than the raw key.

issues.description: The horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel and the category chip row are cut off at the right edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll affordance or fade indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade gradient or scroll indicator so users understand these rows are horizontally scrollable, and ensure card titles truncate gracefully with ellipsis.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies only on a small red dot to convey unread status, with no text label or badge count, which can be hard to perceive.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a numeric badge for clarity.
